newsitem.title: USA: Gillette Co unit launches new ad campaign.
newsitem.headline: Gillette Co unit launches new ad campaign.

text.p: Duracell North Atlantic Group said on Thursday it would air new TV spots in an advertizing campaign to meet Energizer head-on in the battle to battery superiority.

The new 30- and 15-second spots will air nationally on network and cable television beginning Thursday, Duracell said in a statement, and represent the company's latest effort in a marketing strategy aimed at establishing Duracell as the prevailing long-lasting battery brand.

The new spots, created by Ogilvy & Mather Advertising, feature a competition between electronic devices powered by Duracell and Energizer batteries. By the end of the competition, Energizer battery-operated toys begin to fade, while Duracell-powered devices continue to run.
Duracell is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Gillette Co that manufactures and markets alkaline batteries.
